sourceText:
Quick Potato Wedges..
By: Usha Chowdhary Gupta
Published: Thursday, May 12, 2011 - 5:46am

Ingredients




4 tablespoons Olive Oil,
1/2 teaspoon Salt
1/4 teaspoon Pepper Powder,
1/2 teaspoon each Basil, Thyme, Oregano
1/4 teaspoon Paprika or Chilly flakes,
4 Potatoes, cut in wedges (quarters),
4 tablespoons Grated Parmesan Cheese

Preparation

1 Mix oil and seasonings together. Roll the cut potato wedges in the mixture. 2 Put on a baking dish. Bake at 450 degrees for 15 minutes. Sprinkle Parmesan cheese on the potatoes. Bake for few minutes, until cheese melts. Serve hot… 3 Oven temperature is 230 degrees centigrade.
